lines: - A test can hold multiple locks, and accepts a for the whole group. Learn more about .
- and called without a selector search in any frame of the subtree, so you no longer need to locate the iframe first:
- // Finds the button in any frame on the page. await page . frameLocator ( ) . getByRole ( 'button' ) . click ( ) ;
- // Finds the button in any frame on the page.
- The rest of the locator resolves inside a single frame, just like a regular locator, and an error is thrown when it matches elements in several frames.
- New returns a locator that matches only visible elements. It is the recommended replacement for the CSS pseudo-class:
- Steps now carry structured data for reporters. Playwright API steps report the target locator and call arguments, and accepts and options for your own steps:

- Reporters receive them via and . For Playwright API steps, the subtitle is the locator or the navigation url — for example, with subtitle . Both are rendered next to the step title in the trace viewer and the HTML report.
- 🖼️ Aria and screen snapshots in traces
- The option of and the fixture option now accept an object selecting what to capture on every action:
